title: Characterization of the centrally finite Amitsur-Small division rings
summary: In 1978, Amitsur and Small asked whether, for every division ring $D$, maximal left ideals of $D[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ contract to maximal left ideals in smaller polynomial subrings. Chapman and the author showed that the answer is negative in general and called $D$ an Amitsur-Small ring when this contraction property always holds.
